title: FollowFlow batch pad — Zoe (2026-10-21)
body:
Quick context: running a midday batch of touchpoints for expansion/opportunity hygiene. 2h block: 9:30–11:30 PT. Goal = 18 dials, 6 VM, 4 connects, 2 SQLs. Focus: info-gap accounts + re-engage POCs who warmed in Q3.

Priority list (order to call):
1) MicroVolt (ACV $85k) — POC: Sara Cullen (Director Eng). Last touched 2026-09-28 (demo). Problem: uncertain about dedicated vs hosted. Ask: must-have infra constraints?
   - Notes: saw new job posting for infra lead — leverage as opening. Email thread: "re: infra cadence" (sent 10/5).
   - Next step if connect: propose quick ROI snippet + pricing sleeved for 3-mo pilot.
2) Hummingway Health — POC: Marco D. (ML Platform). Last demo 2026-07-12, low usage.
   - Hook: new privacy features (KMS/HSM) + private deployment case studies.
   - Objection script: "we already use managed endpoints" -> "Difference is predictability & unit-economics for sustained inference."
3) Castor Apps — AE referral intro (warm). POC: Lina (prod). Need calendar.
4) EmberPay — reconnect after contract pause. CFO looped in earlier.

Call patterns / scripts (short):
- Connect opening (15s): "Hi Sara — Zoe Patel at Redwood Inference. Quick question — are you still leading infra for LLM infra at MicroVolt?"
- If yes: "We built guardrails for predictable latency + fallback routing that customers use to avoid service blips during spikes. Curious if you have 10 minutes this week to hear 2 examples where that saved customers $$$?"
- VM/No answer VM (10s): "Hi Sara, Zoe from Redwood. Quick callback at 415-555-01xx or reply — I have a short idea on reducing inference cost for peak windows. Thanks."

Email subject variants to A/B:
- "MicroVolt — quick idea to cut inference spend at peak"
- "Ideas for predictable LLM latency — 10 min?"

On-hand data points to use:
- Avg token cost delta for batching: 30–45% (from Optimize internal runbook). Confluence note: /Optimize/batching-summary (linked above).
- Case: MedlyCare cut 42% cost last q w/ Dedicated + KV caching. (Quote in playbook)

Objections cheat sheet:
- "We can self-host" -> "Totally — teams still underestimate end-to-end ops (patching, kernel selection, rollout). We can share runbook and a quick estimate for your current model mix."
- "Security concerns" -> "We offer Private w/ KMS/HSM + audit logs; happy to pull SRE/security PM for a short call."

Pipeline hygiene tasks (post-batch):
- Update stage for MicroVolt -> proposal (attach pilot pricing) if connect.
- Hummingway -> tag as "needs-privacy-case-study" and email Marco the one-pager.
- EmberPay -> re-open CFO thread, drop intro to finance sales lead.

Metrics to log (quick):
- Total dials: ____
- Connects: ____
- VMs left: ____
- SQLs opened: ____

Notes to self / friction points:
- Need a concise 1-paragraph ROI for 3-mo pilot (ops savings + latency SLA improvement) — ask Solutions Eng for a templated snippet (Maya?).
- Check with Platform team on Dedicated burst policy updates (ticket G2M-879).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who owns MicroVolt infra contact now? Confirm on LinkedIn before calling.
- Get updated private-deploy pricing grid (last updated 2026-06).

End-of-block quick template for Slack update to #ae-live: "Batch done — 21 dials, 5 connects, 3 VMs left. MicroVolt -> asked for pilot ROI; looping SE Maya for pricing snippet. Leaving notes in CRM."

Random scratch ideas (brain-dump):
- Create 30s Loom template demo showing fallback routing during a region outage — use in voicemails/email links.
- Small win: bring up quantization/kv-cache combo as instant savings in emails (makes subject line tangible).

Reminders:
- Log call dispositions immediately.
- Attach relevant Confluence links in CRM notes.

End.
